sentences.en: The pyramids are the most famous monuments of ancient Egypt and still hold enormous interest for people in the present day.
sentences.zh: 金字塔是古埃及最著名的纪念性建筑，至今仍让人们深感兴趣。

sentences.en: These grand, impressive tributes to the memory of the Egyptian kings have become linked with the country even though other cultures, such as the Chinese and Mayan, also built pyramids.
sentences.zh: 这些为纪念埃及国王而建的建筑宏伟壮观，人们一提到它们便会想到埃及，尽管中华文明、玛雅文明等也建造过金字塔。

sentences.en: The evolution of the pyramid form has been written and argued about for centuries.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，人们不断撰文探讨、争论金字塔的形制是怎样演变的。

sentences.en: However, there is no question that, as far as Egypt is concerned, it began with one monument to one king designed by one brilliant architect: the Step Pyramid of Djoser at Saqqara.
sentences.zh: 不过，就埃及而言，金字塔形制的演变无疑始于一位杰出的建筑师为一位国王设计的一座纪念建筑，即位于萨卡拉的左塞尔阶梯金字塔。

sentences.en: Djoser was the first king of the Third Dynasty of Egypt and the first to build in stone.
sentences.zh: 左塞尔是埃及第三王朝的第一位国王，也是第一位以石材营建的国王。

sentences.en: Prior to Djoser’s reign, tombs were rectangular monuments made of dried clay brick, which covered underground passages where the deceased person was buried.
sentences.zh: 在左塞尔统治之前，墓葬是用晒干的泥砖建成的长方形建筑，下方覆盖着埋葬死者的地下通道。

sentences.en: For reasons which remain unclear, Djoser’s main official, whose name was Imhotep, conceived of building a taller, more impressive tomb for his king by stacking stone slabs on top of one another, progressively making them smaller, to form the shape now known as the Step Pyramid.
sentences.zh: 出于至今尚不清楚的原因，左塞尔的首席大臣伊姆霍特普想为国王建造一座更高、更气派的陵墓。他的构想是把石板层层叠起，让它们逐层缩小，从而形成今天所说的阶梯金字塔的形状。

sentences.en: Djoser is thought to have reigned for 19 years, but some historians and scholars attribute a much longer time for his rule, owing to the number and size of the monuments he built.
sentences.zh: 一般认为左塞尔在位19年，但一些历史学家和学者根据他所建纪念建筑的数量和规模，推断他的统治时间要长得多。

sentences.en: The Step Pyramid has been thoroughly examined and investigated over the last century, and it is now known that the building process went through many different stages.
sentences.zh: 在过去一个世纪里，人们对阶梯金字塔进行了深入考察和研究。如今已经知道，它的建造经历了许多不同阶段。

sentences.en: Historian Marc Van de Mieroop comments on this, writing ‘Much experimentation was involved, which is especially clear in the construction of the pyramid in the center of the complex.
sentences.zh: 历史学家马克·范德米鲁普就此写道：“建造过程中进行了大量尝试，这一点在建筑群中心那座金字塔的施工过程中尤为明显。

sentences.en: It had several plans ... before it became the first Step Pyramid in history, piling six levels on top of one another ...
sentences.zh: 它的设计方案几经更改……最终才成了历史上第一座阶梯金字塔，六层逐级叠起……

sentences.en: The weight of the enormous mass was a challenge for the builders, who placed the stones at an inward incline in order to prevent the monument breaking up.’
sentences.zh: 这座庞然大物的重量给建造者带来了难题。他们把石块向内倾斜着铺放，以防建筑体散开。”

sentences.en: When finally completed, the Step Pyramid rose 62 meters high and was the tallest structure of its time.
sentences.zh: 阶梯金字塔最终建成时高达62米，是当时最高的建筑。

sentences.en: The complex in which it was built was the size of a city in ancient Egypt and included a temple, courtyards, shrines, and living quarters for the priests.
sentences.zh: 金字塔所在的建筑群相当于古埃及的一座城市，内有一座神庙，还有庭院、神龛和祭司的住处。

sentences.en: It covered a region of 16 hectares and was surrounded by a wall 10.5 meters high.
sentences.zh: 这片建筑群占地16公顷，四周环绕着一道高10.5米的围墙。

sentences.en: The wall had 13 false doors cut into it with only one true entrance cut into the south-east corner; the entire wall was then ringed by a trench 750 meters long and 40 meters wide.
sentences.zh: 围墙上凿有13道假门，唯一真正的入口开在东南角；整道围墙外围又挖了一条长750米、宽40米的壕沟。

sentences.en: The false doors and the trench were incorporated into the complex to discourage unwanted visitors.
sentences.zh: 建筑群特意设置这些假门和壕沟，是为了阻止不速之客进入。

sentences.en: If someone wished to enter, he or she would have needed to know in advance how to find the location of the true opening in the wall.
sentences.zh: 想要进去的人，必须事先知道怎样找到墙上真正的入口。

sentences.en: Djoser was so proud of his accomplishment that he broke the tradition of having only his own name on the monument and had Imhotep’s name carved on it as well.
sentences.zh: 左塞尔对自己的成就十分自豪，以至于他打破了在纪念建筑上只留下国王本人姓名的传统，让人也把伊姆霍特普的名字刻了上去。

sentences.en: The burial chamber of the tomb, where the king’s body was laid to rest, was dug beneath the base of the pyramid, surrounded by a vast maze of long tunnels that had rooms off them to discourage robbers.
sentences.zh: 安放国王遗体的墓室开凿于金字塔基座下方。墓室四周，纵横的长通道构成了一座巨大的迷宫，通道旁还岔出一间间房室，以阻止盗墓者。

sentences.en: One of the most mysterious discoveries found inside the pyramid was a large number of stone vessels.
sentences.zh: 金字塔内最神秘的发现之一，是数量庞大的石质器皿。

sentences.en: Over 40,000 of these vessels, of various forms and shapes, were discovered in storerooms off the pyramid’s underground passages.
sentences.zh: 在金字塔地下通道旁的储藏室里，人们发现了四万多件这样的器皿，形态各异。

sentences.en: They are inscribed with the names of rulers from the First and Second Dynasties of Egypt and made from different kinds of stone.
sentences.zh: 这些器皿由不同种类的石材制成，上面刻有埃及第一、第二王朝统治者的名字。

sentences.en: There is no agreement among scholars and archaeologists on why the vessels were placed in the tomb of Djoser or what they were supposed to represent.
sentences.zh: 这些器皿为何被放进左塞尔的陵墓，又意在代表什么，学者和考古学家并无一致意见。

sentences.en: The archaeologist Jean-Philippe Lauer, who excavated most of the pyramid and complex, believes they were originally stored and then given a ‘proper burial’ by Djoser in his pyramid to honor his predecessors.
sentences.zh: 考古学家让-菲利普·洛埃尔发掘了金字塔及建筑群的大部分区域。他认为，这些器皿最初被收藏起来，后来左塞尔为了纪念先王，让它们在自己的金字塔里得到“妥善安葬”。

sentences.en: There are other historians, however, who claim the vessels were dumped into the shafts as yet another attempt to prevent grave robbers from getting to the king’s burial chamber.
sentences.zh: 不过，也有历史学家认为，人们把这些器皿倾倒进竖井里，是为了再添一道障碍，阻止盗墓者进入国王的墓室。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, all of the precautions and intricate design of the underground network did not prevent ancient robbers from finding a way in.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，种种防范措施以及地下通道网络的复杂设计，终究没能阻止古时的盗墓者找到进去的路。

sentences.en: Djoser’s grave goods, and even his body, were stolen at some point in the past and all archaeologists found were a small number of his valuables overlooked by the thieves.
sentences.zh: 左塞尔的随葬品，甚至他的遗体，都曾在过去某个时候被盗。考古学家只找到了少量被盗墓者忽略的贵重物品。

sentences.en: There was enough left throughout the pyramid and its complex, however, to astonish and amaze the archaeologists who excavated it.
sentences.zh: 然而，金字塔及其建筑群各处留存的东西，依然足以令参与发掘的考古学家惊叹不已。

sentences.en: Egyptologist Miroslav Verner writes, ‘Few monuments hold a place in human history as significant as that of the Step Pyramid in Saqqara ...
sentences.zh: 埃及学家米罗斯拉夫·韦尔纳写道：“在人类历史上，少有纪念建筑能占据像萨卡拉阶梯金字塔那样重要的地位……

sentences.en: It can be said without exaggeration that this pyramid complex constitutes a milestone in the evolution of monumental stone architecture in Egypt and in the world as a whole.’
sentences.zh: 可以毫不夸张地说，这片金字塔建筑群是埃及乃至全世界大型石造建筑发展史上的一座里程碑。”

sentences.en: The Step Pyramid was a revolutionary advance in architecture and became the archetype which all the other great pyramid builders of Egypt would follow.
sentences.zh: 阶梯金字塔是建筑史上的一项革命性进步，后来埃及其他所有大型金字塔的建造者都以它为范本。

questions.question: The complex that includes the Step Pyramid and its surroundings is considered to be as big as an Egyptian ______ of the past.
The area outside the pyramid included accommodation that was occupied by ______, along with many other buildings and features.
In addition, a long ______ encircled the wall.
As a result, any visitors who had not been invited were cleverly prevented from entering the pyramid grounds unless they knew the ______ of the real entrance.
Which TWO of the following points does the writer make about King Djoser?

options.A: Initially he had to be persuaded to build in stone rather than clay.
options.B: There is disagreement concerning the length of his reign.
options.C: He failed to appreciate Imhotep's part in the design of the Step Pyramid.
options.D: A few of his possessions were still in his tomb when archaeologists found it.
options.E: He criticised the design and construction of other pyramids in Egypt.

questions.logic: B 对应对在位时间的争议。常见的年数是 19 年，部分学者以纪念建筑的数量和规模为由主张更久。D 对应考古发现。墓葬遭盗，却仍留下少数盗墓者漏掉的贵重物品。
